text.p: Flood crests have passed Grand Forks and Fargo in North Dakota, USA. Flooding will be very slow to recede in those areas, however. The flood crest is now moving toward Canada and is expected to arrive in the Winnipeg area early next week. No major storminess is expected in the region the next 3-5 days.

Tropical Storm Jimmy, with 45 mph winds, is in the western Pacific near 21n/156e, moving east northeast at 5 mph. This system is expected to weaken and dissipate as it tracks towards the northeast during the next 24-36 hours. This system is a decreasing risk to shipping during this period.
There are no further statements at this time.
